_: Slat rank system v9. Every supported exercise has its own male/female 46-rank threshold ladder. Thresholds are Slat-owned heuristic benchmarks generated from exercise metadata, exercise-specific difficulty anchors, ROM class and load semantics. They are not population claims.
_legRankNote: Retained for compatibility; ranking uses exercise-specific standards.

sources: Slat-owned exercise-family anchor model and explicit movement metadata; no third-party strength-standard table is copied into the threshold dataset.
General strength-training conventions are used only to choose broad movement-family anchors; Slat does not present them as measured population percentiles.
Obscure variations inherit a documented movement-family anchor from their explicit exercise metadata and remain editable in the source configuration.
ranking.topTierNote: Blue Gem is the final Slat tier of the internal progression; it is not labeled as a population percentile.
ranking.romCorrection: height exponent by ROM; multiplier capped at 0.94–1.06
ranking.ageCorrection: smooth age curve; 20–40 baseline; capped at 1.12
ranking.machineLeniency: encoded in each exercise threshold ladder; no universal machine multiplier
ranking.unilateralRule: unilateral loads are scored per side; bilateral dumbbell loads use both dumbbells
ranking.thresholdGeneration: referenceBW × movementFamilyAnchor × ROMFactor × unilateralFactor × 46-step Slat progression

muscleModel.note: Each muscle is scored only from its mapped exercises; transfer weights remain exercise-specific in app.js.
